body: Use case: stylized-concept. Create original Hazel S 2011 ordinary midsize FOUR-DOOR SEDAN game sprite sheet, 2994 abandoned-world salvage art. Reference image only for painted worn texture, 8-view layout and transparent open wheel arches, NOT its body shape. New distinct long elegant graphite sage-green sedan with ivory replacement front fender, smooth arched roof, substantial separate trunk, clean narrow swept headlights and wide horizontal rear lamps. Stock plain trim, no spoiler, no hood scoop, no racing kit, no badges or logos. Exactly two doors and two handles per side. Eight consistent orthographic views in 4 columns by 2 rows: front, front three-quarter pointing left, right side nose left, rear three-quarter nose right; rear, rear three-quarter nose left, left side nose right, front three-quarter pointing right. Entire sheet wide 3:1. Each car fully separated within its cell. NO wheels or tires, genuinely transparent wheel openings open through lower silhouette. Real transparent background, no ground shadows, no scenery, no text. Same design and color across all views, restrained rust, worn repair plates.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. New original Hazel S 2011 LHD ordinary midsize sedan dashboard overlay for 2994 salvage racing game. Reference only worn texture and transparent overlay structure; make distinct smooth sculpted charcoal dashboard with sage-green replacement trim, ivory repairs, slim horizontal vents, simple center radio/climate stack and passenger glovebox. Wide 2.5:1 canvas. Large completely BLANK opaque black driver instrument binnacle on LEFT, around x230..760 y450..680 in 1983x793 canvas. No gauges, dials, text or numbers painted inside it. Absolutely NO steering wheel or column or hands; runtime adds them. Genuine transparent windscreen above low dashboard, narrow side posts at far edges, no roof top. Straight-on cockpit perspective, dashboard lower half. No scenery, logos, emblems or text. Preserve transparent alpha and clean edges.
